parameters.name: Configuration
parameters.description: The configuration information of the data destination, in JSON string format. The required content varies based on the rule action type. For more information about the requirements and examples, see the description of the **Configuration** parameter in [CreateDestination](~~433032~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the data destination.

parameters.name: DestinationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data destination.

You can call the [ListDestination](~~433025~~) operation to query the list of data destinations and obtain the **DestinationId**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data destination.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The operation type of the data destination. Valid values:

- **REPUBLISH**: forwards the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to another communication topic on IoT Platform.
- **AMQP**: forwards the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to an AMQP consumer group via data forwarding.
- **DATAHUB**: forwards the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for data stream processing.
- **ONS**: forwards the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ for message distribution.
- **MNS**: sends the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: sends the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event computing.
- **OTS**: sends the topic data that is processed by the data parse script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.
